title: DAILY CORN! Copi Cafe Episode 54 | Cornucopias
description:
Get ready for an exciting episode of Copi Cafe! We'll bring you up to speed on the latest player account developments and the highly anticipated desktop launcher. Dive into hot topics like Apple's Vision Pro and its impact on Metaverse Gaming. Explore the COPI Cafe schedule and the Daily Corn challenge seen on Discord. Enjoy an exclusive interview with key team members, Zach and Geoff (Founder). Plus, we'll answer community questions from Discord.

00:00 Beverage Choices
02:33 Player Account
09:36 Desktop Launcher 
11:57 Apple Vision Pro
17:27 Copi Cafe Schedule 
21:58 Daily Corn 
24:03 Leak!
26:27 Zach & Geoff Interview
44:38 Community Questions

Cornucopias is an MMORPG Metaverse game accessible through multiple platforms and created on Unreal Engine 5. 

The vision is to bring freedom, power, autonomy and new economics to the player. 

Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge metaverse experience through immersive gameplay, an exciting story, exceptional artwork and innovative economics.

The Cornucopias Metaverse is a network of floating bubbles and domes, each with diverse themes and characteristics. Here, players of all ages can engage in a series of mini-games and explore vast landscapes in search of precious resources which can be crafted into valuable items. 

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
